names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Νίκων καθηγούμενος της Λαύρας των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου», with the rank word and the office left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 23 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Никон Печерски.“, with the rank word Преподобни left off. Печерски is kept: it is not a rank but the by-name the heading gives him, of the Caves, and it is what this folder's English name already carries. A bare Никон would fold with `nikon-of-sicily`, whose entry stands first on the same day.

death.note: saint.gr heads his page «Οσιος Νικων Καθηγουμενος Της Λαυρας Των Σπηλαιων Του Κιεβου (; - 1088)», leaving the first date a question mark. Its own account gives no year of death in the body, and places his life «στην Ρωσία κατά τον 11ο αιώνα μ.Χ.»

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Νίκων καθηγούμενος της Λαύρας των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page says «Το Λείψανο του Αγίου βρίσκεται αδιάφθορο στη Λαύρα των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου», that his relic lies incorrupt in the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv, and heads him «(; - 1088)». He is not the corpus's Nikon of Sicily, kept on the same 23 March, nor Nikon the disciple of Kuksha, nor Nikon of Optina.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 05.04.2026 (23. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Никон Печерски.“

attestations.note: The day's second and last entry, on the same menologion day the Greek already keeps in this folder, and the same abbot of the Caves: the companion of Anthony of the Caves and spiritual father of Theodosius, who was made abbot in old age and against his will, and whose incorrupt relics lie in the Kyiv caves. The Prologue dates his repose 1066, where this folder holds 1088 from saint.gr; the sourced year is left standing and the disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved. It gives two scenes neither other page had: the danger from prince Izyaslav over his tonsuring of the boyar Barlaam and the eunuch Ephraim, turned aside by the princess, who changed the prince's anger into the fear of God; and the Greek iconographers who came to Kyiv from Constantinople unlooked-for, in answer to his prayer, having seen Anthony and Theodosius in a vision telling them to go to him. `related` goes both ways to `barlaam-of-the-kyiv-caves` and `ephraim-of-the-kyiv-caves`, the two men the entry names as his tonsured, and `ephraim-of-the-kyiv-caves` keeps his own commemoration on this same menologion day in another calendar. The stored form keeps Печерски, which is the by-name the heading gives him and the one this folder's English name already carries; a bare Никон would fold with `nikon-of-sicily`, who is the day's first entry. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
